# Signal to Insight

> A public knowledge system that turns high-signal AI and enterprise sources into practical explanations, reusable patterns, limitations, and applications.

Canonical project: https://github.com/dkharlanau/signal-to-insight
Planned site: https://dkharlanau.github.io/signal-to-insight/
Machine-readable insights: https://dkharlanau.github.io/signal-to-insight/data/insights.json

## Content principles

- Prefer durable insight over news summaries.
- Distinguish source claims from derived analysis.
- Include limitations and counterpoints.
- Translate concepts into concrete enterprise applications.
- Link to original sources rather than reproducing them.
- Do not treat third-party source material as original project content.

## Published insights

### Why enterprise AI agents fail after the POC

Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mav15aW9lLM

Core derived idea: production readiness depends on the controlled execution environment around an AI agent — including authority, execution history, protected data access, human intervention, and replay — rather than model capability alone.

Application: controlled SAP / master-data changes.

Structured record: /data/insights.json
Human-readable source: /content/explainers/001-enterprise-agent-production-substrate.md
